title: Version 0.0.5
body:
Version 0.0.5

December 4th, 2022

Added:

  • Added Buildmode Categories
  • Added ObjectName to BuildMode
  • Added UI sounds to EVERY element

Changed:

  • Mobile buttons now work on BuildMode

Fixed:

  • X Button actually works now
  • BuildMode and Vehicle UI cannot collide anymore
  • Strokes are now on most UIs
  • Changed data serializer used for saving structures
